notes:
Summary: Shearwater is a mid-to-large legal compliance vendor building an internal discovery product for regulated clients (financial services, healthcare). They ingest court filings, contracts, discovery corpora (~120M docs planned), care about embedding quality + a second-stage neural reranker for precision.

Requirements / quotes from calls:
- Must run in VPC/private; eventual on-prem connector for air-gapped customers is required.
- Retention: audit trail + immutable access logs for 7-10 years; retention controls and legal hold capability.
- Security: SSO/SAML + SCIM, SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, customer-managed KMS, HSM optional.
- Latency: end-to-end query (<250ms median for top-10 rerank), tail P95 <400ms for legal workloads.
- Scale: initial index 30-50M docs for PoC, roadmap to 120M+; embeddings storage and rerank compute must be cost-predictable.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement looking for <$0.03/query at scale with caching; willing to pay premium for private deployment and SLOs.
- Model preferences: open LLMs preferred (Llama-family variants), intent to use quantized models (4-bit) for reranker and embedder. Fallback to hosted Redwood models acceptable during outages.

Recent convo snippets/quotes:
- "We need audit logs that are immutable; regulators will ask for chain-of-custody metadata." — Head of Compliance
- "If we can't get predictable cost per query, we'll have trouble selling to banks." — Product Lead

POC scope & success criteria:
- Index 30M sample set; demonstrate 200-250ms median rerank + precision lift vs lexical baseline; show cost model and retention/audit proof.
